reported.name: lnR_num
reported.expr: log((m.n * m.Rm + m.n_s * float(sum(m.sp.wj * m.sp.Rj))) / (m.n + m.n_s))
reported.label: R, number-weighted (nm)
reported.note: all islands / grains counted (main + small population): independent of which population the fit calls 'main'; between the unpenalised and the adopted joint solutions it moves by 4 % (median) / 20 % (p90). Island stage up to about 8 s after the onset is the validated range; later windows are conditional on the adopted family.

reported.name: lnD_num
reported.label: D, all islands (nm)
reported.note: mean centre spacing of all islands / grains (hexagonal equivalent of the number density). all islands / grains counted (main + small population): independent of which population the fit calls 'main'; between the unpenalised and the adopted joint solutions it moves by 4 % (median) / 20 % (p90). Island stage up to about 8 s after the onset is the validated range; later windows are conditional on the adopted family.

reported.name: lnR_mass
reported.expr: log(((1 - m.fs - m.fL) * m.Rm + m.fs * float(sum(m.sp.wj * m.sp.Rj))) / (1 - m.fL))
reported.label: R, mass-weighted (nm)
reported.note: grains that carry the mass above the base (mass-weighted over main + small population, large mounds excluded): the fine grains of a closed film, NOT its dominant lateral scale (see lnR_dom, lnR_L); smooth in time in the adopted solutions, between solutions 4 % (median) / 40-46 % (p90, late film). Island stage up to about 8 s after the onset is the validated range; later windows are conditional on the adopted family.

reported.name: lnD_mass
reported.expr: ((1 - m.fs - m.fL) * log(m.D) + m.fs * log(m.D_s)) / (1 - m.fL)
reported.label: D, mass-weighted (nm)
reported.note: spacing of the grains that carry the mass above the base (large mounds excluded). After closure the counts show a knee without a correlation peak: the spacing is not determined there (it differs by a factor 2-3 between equally good solutions) and it is no longer the lateral scale of the film; use lnR_dom / lnR_L. Before closure: between solutions 4 % (median). Island stage up to about 8 s after the onset is the validated range; later windows are conditional on the adopted family.

reported.name: lnR_dom
reported.expr: np.average(log(np.array([sum(m.wj * m.Rj ** 3) / sum(m.wj * m.Rj ** 2), sum(m.sp.wj * m.sp.Rj ** 4) / sum(m.sp.wj * m.sp.Rj ** 3), sum(m.L.wj * m.L.Rj ** 4) / sum(m.L.wj * m.L.Rj ** 3)])), weights=np.array([(1 - m.fs - m.fL) * m.T, m.fs * m.sp.a * sum(m.sp.wj * m.sp.Rj ** 4) / sum(m.sp.wj * m.sp.Rj ** 3), m.fL * m.L.a * sum(m.L.wj * m.L.Rj ** 4) / sum(m.L.wj * m.L.Rj ** 3)]))
reported.label: dominant lateral feature radius (nm)
reported.note: radius of the population that carries the knee of the horizontal cut: geometric mean of the volume-weighted radii of main grains, small islands and large flat mounds, weighted by mass share x height (the weight of a population in q^2 I, the representation in which the knee is read). The islands before closure, the mounds of the film surface after it (w_L above 0.6). 3.0 x R_dom is the model counterpart of the direct reading obs_L_knee_nm: on the 56 reference windows with a knee inside the q range the ratio is 1.07 (median), 0.73-1.79 (p16-p84). A mound radius far above 30 nm describes a component below the q range, not a feature size (windows of the coalescence stage with dev5 above 4). Island stage up to about 8 s after the onset is the validated range; later windows are conditional on the adopted family.

reported.name: lnR_L
reported.label: mound radius (nm)
reported.note: volume-weighted radius of the large flat mounds (no positional order): the lateral scale of the surface relief of a closed film; before closure a minor low-q term (see w_L). Mounds that overlap in the model (projected coverage above 1) stand for a relief amplitude, their height is then not a morphology value.

reported.name: w_L
reported.expr: np.array([(1 - m.fs - m.fL) * m.T, m.fs * m.sp.a * sum(m.sp.wj * m.sp.Rj ** 4) / sum(m.sp.wj * m.sp.Rj ** 3), m.fL * m.L.a * sum(m.L.wj * m.L.Rj ** 4) / sum(m.L.wj * m.L.Rj ** 3)])[2] / sum(np.array([(1 - m.fs - m.fL) * m.T, m.fs * m.sp.a * sum(m.sp.wj * m.sp.Rj ** 4) / sum(m.sp.wj * m.sp.Rj ** 3), m.fL * m.L.a * sum(m.L.wj * m.L.Rj ** 4) / sum(m.L.wj * m.L.Rj ** 3)]))
reported.label: mound weight in R_dom
reported.note: weight of the mounds in lnR_dom (mass share x height): near 0 island-like, above 0.6 the film-surface relief carries the lateral scale

reported.name: lnR_grain
reported.label: grain radius (nm)
reported.note: volume-weighted radius of the main columnar grains / domes: the fine grain structure of the closed film (5-8 nm in the film-stage test); their spacing is not determined after closure (no correlation peak in the counts). Island stage up to about 8 s after the onset is the validated range; later windows are conditional on the adopted family.

reported.name: cov
reported.label: coverage
reported.note: projected metal coverage of all populations; 13 % (p90) between solutions. Island stage up to about 8 s after the onset is the validated range; later windows are conditional on the adopted family.

reported.name: lnh_mass
reported.label: mass thickness (nm)
reported.note: mass-equivalent thickness (bulk density) = mass factor x deposition rate x time; absolute as far as the rate and the intensity constant hold (fitted mass factors of the reference scans 0.83-0.97)

reported.name: lnt_film
reported.label: mean film thickness (nm)
reported.note: geometric mean thickness: porous base layer (mass / relative density) + the relief above it; 1.0-1.7 x the mass thickness in the reference fits; 14 % (p90) between solutions on top of the mass scale

reported.name: lnH_top
reported.expr: log(max((1 - m.fb) * m.h_tot / min(max(m.coverage + m.n_s * float(sum(m.sp.wj * pi * m.sp.Rj ** 2)), 0.02), 1.0), 0.02))
reported.label: relief height (nm)
reported.note: mean height of the islands (island stage) or of the relief above the dense base (film stage); the split base / relief is weakly determined in the film stage (27 % p90 between solutions, single windows more)

reported.name: f_base
reported.label: dense-base mass fraction
reported.note: share of the mass in the laterally uniform base layer; erratic between windows in the film stage: read only as island-like (near 0) against film-like (near 1)

reported.name: lnR_P
reported.label: radius of the film-density regions (nm)
reported.note: lateral size of the regions where the whole film is sparser / denser; meaningful only where lnA_P is above about -5

reported.name: lnA_P
reported.label: ln of the film-density fluctuation amplitude
reported.note: A_P = area share x (density difference / mean film density)^2; -13.8 = term off
